plain: A researcher named Mike Masters tells, on Jesse Michels's podcast, of a woman called Amy Reynolds. He says her friend Petra watched through a window as she was taken, and soon afterwards they got a call saying Amy had been found at a petrol station 790 kilometres away. Masters calls it one of his favourite cases, since it would suggest that whatever took her could move a person a great distance very quickly.
